articles.title: Witch Bottles and Daisy Wheels: The Secret Magic Hidden in Old Houses
articles.summary: For centuries, people hid magic in their homes to ward off evil. They buried witch bottles in walls, carved stars on beams, and planted rosemary to trap witches. Some chimneys even had seats for flying witches to rest on.

articles.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton Delayed to 2027—Here's What We Know
articles.summary: The Jujutsu Kaisen battle royale game Rumble: Survivaton has been delayed to 2027. Developed by Vampire Survivors studio poncle, it features 20+ fighters and lets you change the rules mid-match. The anime's next season is also expected in 2027.

articles.title: From Shipwreck to Runway: 300-Year-Old Wood Becomes High Fashion
articles.summary: Scientists in Finland transformed 300-year-old shipwreck wood into two elegant dresses. Using the eco-friendly Ioncell method, they spun the wood into yarn that feels like silk and is stronger than cotton. The dresses are now on display in exhibitions.
